name: com.gamelovers.mobileservices
author: Miguel Tomas
description: Mobile platform services for Unity: native UI (alerts/toasts), push notifications, and gesture detection (swipe/drag).

samples.description: Kitchen-sink scene that wires every Mobile Services subsystem (NativeUI / Haptics / Notifications / Device / Permissions / ATT / DeepLink) into one runtime-built canvas.
Designer iteration tool: 3x3 preset grid + sequence recorder + replay. Use on a paired device.
Lifecycle demo: channel CRUD, OperatingMode toggles, background-foreground round trip with reschedule semantics.
MapRoute pattern demo: /promo/:id, /profile/:userId, /settings, cold-start replay through IDeepLinkRouter.
